chapter.verse: Tua ciangin ka khuadakleh Zion Mual tungah Tuuno omin mi 144,000 zong amah tawh om uh a, tua mite a tal tung uhah Tuuno' min leh ama' Pa' min kigelh hi.
Vantung panin tui tampi ging leh kekkia nakpi ging tawh a kibang awging khat ka za hi. Tua ka zak awging pen harp khausai siamte' khausai ging tawh kibang hi.
Amaute in kumpi-tokhom mai, sahing lite' mai leh makaite' mai-ah la thak sa uh hi. Leitung panin a kitankhia sangkhat-thenli-tulli-te lobuang tua la a sa thei om lo hi.

Hihte pen a pumpi uh numei tawh a thanghuaisak lo tangval siangthote ahi uh hi. Hihte mah Tuuno a paina peuh ah a zuite ahi uh hi. Amau pen Pasian leh Tuuno' ading anpal ahi dingin a kitankhia khinsa ahi uh hi.
A kam uhah zuau thu om lo-in amaute sitbaang lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin leitunga omte' kiangah—khualmi, minam, kampau, tualmi a namkimte' kiangah—tawntung Lungdamna Thu tangkokhiat ding a nei vanmi a dang khat vankim lai-a leng ka mu hi.
Tua vanmi in awging lianpi tawh, “Pasian kihta unla minpha pia un. A hang pen ama' thukhenna hunlenai hong tung ta hi. Vantung, leitung, tuipi leh tuinakte a bawlpa amah bia un,” ci hi.
A nihna vanmi dang khat in a masa' nung zui-in, “A thupi Babylon khuapi lian, puk ta, puk ta, ama' bawl nulepa tatkhialhna hanga piang lungsona lengtui, minam citeng a dawnsak khuapi, puk ta,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin a thumna vanmi dang khat in zong amau' nung zui-in awging lianpi tawh hih bangin hong gen hi: “Mi khatpeuh in sapi leh a milim bia-in a tal tung ahihkeileh a khut tungah ciaptehna lim a ngah leh
Pasian' hehna hai sungah a ciik sinsen-a kisung lungsona lengtui dawnkha ding a, vanmi siangthote' mai leh Tuuno' mai-ah mei leh kaat tawh gawtna tuak ding hi.
Gawtna meikhu pen a tawntung a tawntungin khuto a, sapi leh ama' milim a bia hih mite hitaleh, ama' min ciaptehna lim a ngah khempeuh hitaleh, a sun a zanin tawldam hun nei lo uh hi.”
Hih thu ah Pasian' thupiaknate a zui, Jesu a upna uh a kem mi siangthote' ading thuakzawhna a kisam ahi hi.

Tua ciangin vantung panin awging khat ka za a, “Hih thu gelh in: Tu-a kipan Topa' sungah a si misite thuphangah ahi uh hi,” ci hi. Kha in, “Hi taktak hi! Amaute a sepkhiatna uh in zui a, a gimnate uh pan a tawldam nading uh ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh meiilom a paak khat om hi. Tua tungah mihing' tapa tawh a kibang khat tu a, a lu tungah kham kumpi-lukhu khat khu-in a khut ah phiaukawi a hiam khat tawi hi.

Biakinnpi sungpan vanmi a dang khat hong pusuakin meii tunga tu pen' kiangah awging lianpi tawh, “Na phiaukawi zangkhia inla anla in. A hang pen anlak nading hunlenai tung ta, leitung ah ante min ta hi,” ci-in kiko hi.
Meii tunga tu pen in zong leitung lamah a phiaukawi vik a, leitung ah an kila hi.
Tua ciangin vantunga biakinnpi sungpan vanmi a dang khat hong pusuak a, tua in zong phiaukawi a hiam khat mah nei hi.

Biakpiaktau panin zong vanmi dang khat hong pusuak a, amah pen meikuang tungah ukzawhna thu a nei ahi hi. Amah in phiaukawi hiam a tawi pen' kiangah awging lianpi tawh, “Na phiaukawi zangkhia inla leitung lenggui pan lenggahbawkte kaikhawm in. A hang pen lenggahte min ta hi,” ci-in kiko hi.
Tua ciangin vanmi in leitung lamah a phiaukawi vikin leitung lengguite kaikhawm a, Pasian' lungsona ahi lengtui bawlna bung lianpi sungah lawnsuk hi.
Tua ciangin khuapua ah lenggah cilna bung kituancil hi. Tua bung sungpan sisan a luangkhia pen sakol kamkaih tanin sang a, tai zanih dektak sau hi.
